subject: T-0177 addendum: 'opened for', not a title
body:
Addendum to T-0177, from my last message — I want to be precise about item 1,
because "render the topic" on its own would still confuse the leader.

`hello`'s topic is *why the channel was opened*, and it is a historical fact. If
we render it as the chat header the leader reads "Transport test: can a Claude
Code session and a Codex session reach each other" above 71 work items — which
is a different confusion, not less of one.

So label it as what it is: **"opened for: …"**, not as a title. And put the
current facts next to it, which we already have in the payload and do not
render: `tasks_recorded`, `tasks_store_exists`, `phase`, participants, and the
last-message time. The discrepancy is the information. "opened for: transport
test · 71 items · COMMIT" tells the leader immediately that a smoke-test channel
became the project channel — which is true, and which nobody could see before.

Do not rewrite the manifest topic. It is a record of why the channel exists.
Not in scope.
